category.reason: The task requires comparing storage capacities against a cash budget or a zero-down monthly payment limit to identify the highest affordable option.

instruction.en: I have $1,199 in cash, or I can afford a zero-down payment plan of $61 per month. Help me choose the highest configuration I can afford.
instruction.zh: 我现在有 $1,199 的现金，或者我每个月可以承受 $61 的 0 首付分期付款，帮我选择我可以承担的最高配置。

reference.patch: Replaced the original English instruction “choose the 1Tb storage” with a request to choose the highest storage configuration affordable with $1,199 in cash or a zero-down monthly payment of at most $61, and added instruction.zh by translating the revised English instruction. Changed groundTruth from [723.0, 1801.0, 806.0, 1472.0] to [622.0, 1801.0, 705.0, 1472.0] in [top, right, bottom, left] pixel coordinates, moving the target from the 1 TB option to the 512 GB option, whose listed monthly payment is $58.29. Changed category.item from Basic Element to Reasoning and updated category.reason to describe comparing the prices with the two budget limits.
